description: The Ahmedabad study builds an EPANET 2.0 hydraulic model for a pilot district-metered area in Jodhpur using municipal population, elevation, pipe and demand information. This resource is provided by Sejal D Desai; Dr. Gargi Rajpara. Coverage is city as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence terms are linked in the provider metadata and require reading before reuse. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The study evaluates a transition from intermittent to continuous supply; its publication abstract does not demonstrate sustained operational performance. For simulation, it documents an application that can inform scenario design. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
